cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: dependent
status: specd
depends_on: 002 003
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-dependent.md; printf -- '---
id: 002
title: dep-a
status: done
---
body
' > factory/specs/002-dep-a.md; printf -- '---
id: 003
title: dep-b
status: done
---
body
' > factory/specs/003-dep-b.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; CLAIMED=$(tracker_claim specd building build-loop); jq -n --arg claimed "$CLAIMED" --arg s1 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-dependent.md status)" '{claimed: $claimed, s1: $s1}'
_note: every listed dependency is done (merged) — the dependent must claim normally; also covers multi-id depends_on parsing
